opening.argument: The video promotes BitConnect through a direct referral invitation, telling viewers to join a BitConnect team while describing the conversion of bitcoin into BitConnect Coin for use on its lending platform. It also presents participation as a way to "start earning bitcoin yourself" and predicts that the coin will increase in value, linking prospective earnings and appreciation to the promoted offer. Those are positive, participation-based benefits, not merely neutral discussion of a digital asset. The separate commentary about ICOs being a scam does not support or establish the BitConnect offer itself. The available evidence does not show completed transfers, realized earnings, or whether the predicted appreciation occurred, so the claim rests on the promotion and promised prospective benefits.
